newsitem.title: UK: Bank America recommends switch to Russia MinFin 4s.
newsitem.headline: Bank America recommends switch to Russia MinFin 4s.

text.p: Bank of America is recommending investors switch to Russian MinFin 4s from MinFin 3s and 5s. "The bullet trade picks up 28 basis points of spread; our target is flat, perhaps even recovering the mid-September low of minus 25 basis points for owning the centre against the wings," analyst Richard Gray said in a note to investors.
He notes that MinFin 4 is the closest in duration to Russia's upcoming eurobond and the spread on the latter of some 325 basis points gives a generous 290 basis point premium to the 4s.
MinFin 4s have also been held back by the saga of stolen and frozen bonds and this is in the process of being resolved, Gray says. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
